offer.name: KnownFix
offer.description: Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

backend.note: Health-checked live at build time, but this URL rotates and dies with the operator machine. If it stops responding, re-read this document before paying — never pay while it is down.

settlement.network: base-sepolia (TESTNET — currency has no value; faucet ETH works)
rules: only purchase when backend.status is 'live-ephemeral' AND backend.url is non-null
one mined payment of >= perFixWei to payTo redeems exactly one fix request
a tx hash can never be redeemed twice
alternative: day-pass tokens via the hmac-token scheme, issued by the operator after checkout
